$comment: Record commands the admin console dispatches through POST /platform-runtime/:moduleKey/:id/actions/:action, per module. Shared by two specs because neither workspace can import the other: apps/admin/lib/runtime/record-action-routing.spec.ts derives this list from the admin module registry and the record action handler and fails if it differs; services/api/src/modules/platform-runtime/record-action-dispatch.spec.ts proves PlatformRuntimeService.execute dispatches every entry. A command added to the registry that reaches the API therefore has to be added here, and then has to be implemented. EXECPLAN-0055 WP-01.
